description: US national accounts from the Bureau of Economic Analysis (official API): any NIPA table (e.g. T10101 real GDP percent change, T10105 GDP in dollars, T20100 personal income) at annual, quarterly or monthly frequency for chosen years, returned as BEA publishes the rows (line, description, period, value, unit). Requires the operator's free BEA API UserID. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

years.description: Comma-separated years or X for all, e.g. 2025,2026
